decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings belong to the core drainage families, but their absence from the website in 2020–2021 weakens the evidence that they meet aspirations, so the firm keeps them with moderate risk.
Floor-level shower drainage fits the firm's strategic direction toward accessible, low-profile bathrooms, so management keeps it despite less visibility, using slack to carry it.

The backflow-protected basement drain meets a clear safety and regulatory need and was a specific development, so without evidence of a shortfall there is no reason to search for other uses of its resources.

The air-admittance valve is peripheral to the bathroom-design focus and has not been visible since 2018, and the firm has shown it will prune its range, so its resources are better moved to core development.
